population.span: In a randomized, open-label, event-driven, noninferiority trial involving 4832 patients who had acute symptomatic pulmonary embolism with or without deep-vein thrombosis

endpoint.span: Major bleeding was observed in 26 patients (1.1%) in the rivaroxaban group and 52 patients (2.2%) in the standard-therapy group

estimate.span: Major bleeding was observed in 26 patients (1.1%) in the rivaroxaban group and 52 patients (2.2%) in the standard-therapy group (hazard ratio, 0.49; 95% CI, 0.31 to 0.79; P=0.003).

treatment_strategy.span: we compared rivaroxaban (15 mg twice daily for 3 weeks, followed by 20 mg once daily) with standard therapy with enoxaparin followed by an adjusted-dose vitamin K antagonist for 3, 6, or 12 months

follow_up.span: adjusted-dose vitamin K antagonist for 3, 6, or 12 months

absent_reason.analysis_set: Neither abstract names the analysis population for the major-bleeding HR. The registry has no standalone major-bleeding result with an HR: its valid-for-safety population statement is attached to Outcome 5 (clinically relevant bleeding, the major+CRNM composite), and its 'Major bleeding' measurement (Outcome 8, 1.4% vs 2.4%) is an ITT net-clinical-benefit component with different values. Not inferred.

candidate_rejections.span: The principal safety outcome occurred in 10.3% of patients in the rivaroxaban group and 11.4% of those in the standard-therapy group (hazard ratio, 0.90; 95% CI, 0.76 to 1.07; P=0.23).
candidate_rejections.why: Principal safety outcome = major OR clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding (composite), not major bleeding alone.

candidate_rejections.span: RESULT OUTCOME 8 MEASUREMENT Major bleeding: Rivaroxaban (Xarelto, BAY59-7939)=1.4; Enoxaparin/VKA=2.4
candidate_rejections.why: Major bleeding as a component of the net-clinical-benefit/efficacy component table in the ITT population; percentages differ from the abstract's principal-safety major bleeding (1.1% vs 2.2%) and no HR is given.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Acute symptomatic PE with or without DVT is a subset of acute symptomatic VTE; comparator is enoxaparin followed by a VKA.
entry_population_matches_question.span: 4832 patients who had acute symptomatic pulmonary embolism with or without deep-vein thrombosis

notes: EINSTEIN-PE (NCT00439777). Served row 0.49 (0.31-0.79) matches the abstract's major bleeding HR exactly. Abstract-only (records.json and europepmc_core.json carry identical content); no full text held. Per-arm denominators are not in the estimate span (registry safety-set denominators 2412/2405 belong to Outcome 5). Follow-up is the intended treatment duration (3, 6 or 12 months).
